steps.title: We connect your systems
steps.body: HiBiz integrates with your POS, inventory, CRM, and ops tools. No code, no complexity — we handle the full setup.

steps.title: The agent monitors 24/7
steps.body: Our AI constantly watches your data — tracking trends, spotting drops, and flagging what needs attention before you even ask.

steps.title: You get answers on WhatsApp
steps.body: Ask anything, anytime. Or just wait — HiBiz proactively sends you alerts and daily summaries straight to your phone.

items.title: Instant business answers
items.body: Ask "How much did I sell yesterday?" or "Which branch is underperforming?" and get a clear, data-backed answer in seconds.

items.title: Proactive alerts
items.body: HiBiz notifies you the moment something needs attention — unusual drops, stock running low, delayed payments — before it becomes a problem.

items.title: Universal integrations
items.body: Connects to your POS, inventory, scheduling, and payment tools and unifies everything into one intelligent layer.

items.title: Daily briefings & KPIs
items.body: Wake up to a morning briefing of what happened, what's trending, and where to focus today — delivered on WhatsApp.

items.title: Multi-location control
items.body: Running multiple branches or teams? Compare performance across all locations and spot gaps the moment they appear.

items.title: Decision support
items.body: Not just data — context. HiBiz explains what's behind the numbers and surfaces what action makes the most sense next.
